caseName: Fenton v. School Committee of Boston
caseNameFull: Fenton v. School Committee of Boston

opinions.text: Appeal from Sup. Jud. Ct. Mass. Motion of National Education Assn, for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Appeal dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.
